subject: Hand-off Roundtable: suggested rolling demo hours
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Hand-off Roundtable: suggested rolling demo hours

Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for the productive discovery earlier. Quick recap and a concrete proposal to make scheduling easy across your global stakeholders:

Recap (one-liner): Novus wants a recurring technical deep-dive cadence that rotates so the same folks don’t have to attend every week (we agreed on a 3-week rotation covering US / EU / APAC-friendly windows).

Proposal (simple, actionable):
- We suggest a "Hand-off Roundtable" cadence: a 60-minute technical session once per week, with the time slot rotating each week so the 3 primary regions get one convenient window every 3 weeks.
- Proposed rotation (example):
  * Week A (US-friendly): Tue 09:00–10:00 PT / Tue 18:00–19:00 CET (good for west coast + late EU)
  * Week B (EU-friendly): Wed 16:00–17:00 CET / Wed 07:00–08:00 PT (better for EU mornings, US early)
  * Week C (APAC-friendly): Thu 08:30–09:30 SGT / Wed 16:30–17:30 PT (evening APAC, late afternoon PT)

Notes:
- We can keep a single recurring calendar series and mark which weeks are which; attendees can opt into the weeks that work for them.
- If Novus prefers a different rhythm (e.g., 2-week rotation or biweekly handoffs), we can adapt — this is just a starting template.

Ask: could you please 1) confirm whether the three-window rotation sounds reasonable and 2) indicate which week(s) your technical leads prefer to attend initially? If helpful I can send a Doodle/poll but the quickest route is to pick the pattern and we’ll seed the calendar invites.

I’ve attached a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) that maps each session to the expected agenda and owners (docs attached). Priyom will cover the EU-friendly weeks and I’ll take the US weeks; Aditya is looping in to own calendar invites and account-level follow-ups.

Thanks — looking forward to locking the first two sessions so your teams can plan.

Best,
Irene

Thanks Irene — this format looks promising. A couple quick things:

- High level: Novus wants one recurring slot; rotating weeks sounds like the cleanest way to get broad engagement without burning out the same engineers.
- Preferences: our engineering leads in NY and Berlin prefer the EU-friendly and US-friendly windows respectively; APAC coverage is lighter so the APAC-friendly week should be optional for most of our team.
- Immediate ask: can we seed the first two weeks (Week A and Week B) so we can block calendars?

I’m fine with the example times you proposed. For the first two sessions, could we do:
- Week A (US-friendly): Tue Jun 1, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Week B (EU-friendly): Wed Jun 9, 16:00–17:00 CET

I’ll invite our engineering manager (A. Chen) to those events after you send the invites. Also please add a short agenda line for each session — that helps with invites.
